Translate between five languages

English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese support 20 distinct translation directions. Upload EPUB, TXT, DOCX, MD or Markdown and receive an EPUB. Choose bilingual output, a translation strategy and a glossary. Review important passages against the original.

Proofread in the original language

Proofreading supports one EPUB, TXT, DOCX or Markdown at a time in all five languages. English, Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese review spelling, grammar and word choice without translation. Simplified Chinese reviews regional wording. Translation and proofreading are separate jobs.

TXT import and proofreading changes

Import UTF-8 or BOM-marked UTF-16 text. Common Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean chapter headings become EPUB contents entries. After proofreading, compare the original and revised passages, keep or reject changes, and download your selection. This does not overwrite the original result or call the model again. Older jobs may not have change records.

Repair and format EPUBs

Repair begins with a diagnosis of EPUB package structure and resource references. Chinese script conversion supports Taiwan, Hong Kong/Macau and general profiles. Choose Kindle, Apple Books or generic layout settings. Basic conversion accepts TXT, EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, DOCX and Markdown and outputs EPUB; protected or unreadable files cannot be processed.

What PDF conversion supports

The separate PDF-to-EPUB tool handles text-based PDFs, preserving original text and images after a layout-risk check. Scanned PDF OCR, PDF translation and PDF proofreading are not available. Complex layouts may be rejected.

Pricing and PayPal

With Alipay, basic conversion costs CNY 0.99 per book and EPUB repair costs CNY 5.99 per book. Both cost US$0.99 per book with PayPal. Translation and proofreading are quoted separately. PayPal AI orders have a US$1.49 minimum; the displayed USD total includes payment processing fees. Review the final file-specific quote before paying.

Start a job and return later

Open the tools, upload a file you have permission to process, select the language and service, and confirm the quote before paying. Processing runs on the server. Return to the task centre in the same browser to check progress and download. Save your result promptly; do not pay again to recover an existing job.
